nimble.claim: Mercury launched Mercury Payroll on Oct 20, 2026, letting founders run W-2 and 1099 payroll, benefits, and tax compliance from their Mercury account with AI assistance via Mercury Command; it is free through Dec 31, 2026, then $100/month plus $50/month per person paid starting Jan 1, 2027.
On Oct 15, 2026, Mercury enabled ChatGPT and Claude to move money, pay recipients, and categorize transactions on a Mercury account via MCP, with every action requiring user approval.
As of Oct 14, 2026, Mercury added faster priority support for customers on its paid Plus and Pro subscription plans, while all customers retain 24/7 support.

On Oct 14, 2026, Mercury released the ability to link multiple Mercury accounts to move money between them, with instant transfers between accounts on the same partner bank, auto-transfer rules, and recurring external transfers.
On Sep 29, 2026, Mercury added real-time payments to its API (paymentMethod: realTimePayment), delivering funds in seconds 24/7/365 on Business and Personal accounts provided through Column, N.A.
On Sep 28, 2026, Mercury enabled wire drawdowns from accounts provided through both Column, N.A. and Choice Financial Group, so payroll providers like Sequoia and Gusto can withdraw funds directly.

exa.claim: On 2026-09-28, Mercury added wire drawdowns that let payroll providers such as Sequoia and Gusto withdraw funds directly from eligible Mercury accounts.
On 2026-09-29, the Mercury API added real-time payments via the realTimePayment payment method, with funds arriving in seconds around the clock for eligible Business and Personal accounts.
On 2026-10-14, Mercury let customers connect multiple Mercury accounts, move money between eligible accounts, create auto-transfer rules, and schedule recurring external transfers.
On 2026-10-14, Mercury made faster priority support available to Plus and Pro customers while retaining 24/7 support for all customers.
On 2026-10-15, Mercury enabled customers to ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay recipients, or categorize transactions, with approval required before actions execute.
On 2026-10-20, Mercury launched Mercury Payroll for W-2 employees and 1099 contractors, with benefits, 401(k) options, tax and compliance handling, and coverage in all 50 states.

On 2026-10-15, Mercury released a feature letting customers ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay recipients and categorize transactions on Mercury accounts, with approval required before money moves.
On 2026-10-14, Mercury added priority support for Plus and Pro subscribers, while all customers retain round-the-clock support.

On 2026-10-14, Mercury released linked accounts features: customers can connect multiple Mercury accounts, transfer directly between them, automate linked-account transfers and schedule recurring payments to external bank accounts.
On 2026-09-29, the Mercury API added real-time payments arriving in seconds, including nights, weekends and holidays, for Mercury Business and Personal accounts provided through Column, N.A.
